history.summary: Comprehensively rebuilt the game-activity exclusion list after a third false positive, and fixed a startup race that could leave a stale second instance unresponsive to Quit, Check for updates, and Refresh.

Hybrid local game-activity detection: Steam, Epic (Heroic on Linux), GOG, Microsoft Store, and Battle.net, plus manual mapping — no launcher account connection required.
